description_en: Enables or disables Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC) for a domain name. This feature is available only to users of paid Alibaba Cloud DNS
description_zh: 开启/关闭域名的DNSSEC服务，仅支持付费版DNS用户
kebab_example: aliyun alidns set-domain-dnssec-status --domain-name example.com --status ON --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDomainDnssecStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The domain name for which you want to enable DNSSEC. This feature is available only to users of paid Alibaba Cloud DNS
parameters.help_zh: 要开启DNSSEC服务的DNS域名，仅支持付费版DNS用户
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of DNSSEC. Valid values:

ON: Enables DNSSEC.

OFF: Disables DNSSEC
parameters.help_zh:
Dnssec状态：

ON 开启
OFF 关闭
parameters.name: status
